  elif [[ "$FUZZING_ENGINE" = "honggfuzz" ]]; then

     printf -- "--dictionary %s" "$dict"
  else
     printf "Unexpected FUZZING_ENGINE: $FUZZING_ENGINE, ignoring\n" >&2
  fi

  [[ "$FUZZING_ENGINE" != "centipede" ]] && return

if [ ! -z "$DEBUGGER" ]; then

fi

def be16(x): return struct.pack('>H', x)
def sig(s): return s.encode('ascii')

# B curves: 3 embedded 'curv' elements with DIFFERENT entry counts

for c in (b'\x00\x01', b'\x00\x02', b'\x00\x02'):

    curves += sig('curv') + be32(0)
    if c == b'\x00\x01':
